tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: [Post] ... Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Marketing Cloud. * Salesforce Data 360 (Data ... WE'RE H…
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in joining Allied Global Tech for your enterprise e-commerce and integration initiatives. With over 5 years of hands-on experience building, extending, and supporting large-scale enterprise commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in backend architecture, headless APIs, and complex data integrations.

bullets.label: Enterprise Commerce & Headless APIs
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), customising Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless data exchange with storefront and third-party consumers.

bullets.label: Complex Data & System Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built, and optimized high-volume data pipelines using Profisee PIM, Hotfolders, and DataHub, resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and global e-commerce channels.

bullets.label: Backend Architecture & Performance
bullets.text: Engineered robust backend functionality and led database query refactoring using Java, Spring, and FlexibleSearch, significantly reducing response latency and improving transaction speed in production environments.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Analysis
bullets.text: Bridged business and technical teams by translating complex requirements into functional specifications, writing user stories, and driving end-to-end integration solutions across international stakeholders.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with a last working day of 15.12.2026 and an earliest start date of 16.12.2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my enterprise commerce and integration background aligns with your team's goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and integration expertise to Allied Global Tech. Building high-performance platforms, designing robust backend data pipelines, and connecting complex enterprise systems like PIM, ERP, and MDM are my core strengths. I look forward to helping your team deliver scalable, robust solutions for international clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise, robust backend engineering in Java and Spring, and proven data integration capabilities to drive high-performance enterprise platforms at Allied Global Tech.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce, Java/Spring backend development, and complex system integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in Allied Global Tech's engineering roles. I hold a valid German work permit and am available from 16.12.2026.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: [Post] ... Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Marketing Cloud. * Salesforce Data 360 (Data ... WE'RE H… - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the open position at Allied Global Tech. With over 5 years of professional experience engineering enterprise e-commerce platforms, RESTful APIs, and complex data integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical depth in Java, Spring, and SAP Commerce Cloud.

I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit, and can start on 16.12.2026 following my notice period. I look forward to speaking with you soon.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
